references.finding: Proprietary Xochitl has no compatibility guarantee. Handwriting pages are separate binary files; original PDF is separate. The vendor says Xochitl should not run while stored documents are accessed or changed.

Uses hashed model/context members, firstFolderId, firstDocumentId, and current item id for navigation. No device validation here; no export contract established.
Current inventory includes the inspected image and navigation patches. Source inspection is not firmware/device acceptance.

blockers.description: The inspected interfaces do not establish safe registration of a received image/PDF and a server folder in the normal stock library. A filesystem folder or image sticker is not that registration.
blockers.required_evidence: A safe stock operation on the tested firmware that accepts the received synthetic source and yields a stable document/folder identity visible through normal tablet operations.
